decision.reason: The saved authorization permits only read-only Central US preparation. The prior East US 2 deployment grant stopped on failure and is not reusable. The repaired foundation now has actual independent previews and an explicit staged installation plan. Foundation installation produces the environment and identity outputs needed for dependent checks; those outputs are not user inputs. A truthful foundation-only review can disclose these limits without pretending full runtime readiness or granting directory permissions. The user must explicitly authorize, retain local-only work or revise the scope.
choices: Authorize Central US shared foundation only
